label: few-shot calibration — HIGH anchor
artifact: illustrative, not an FSK product — a support-ticket tool with a deliberate, domain-tied identity
description: The same functional shape as any ticket tool (list/detail/edit/status) but with visible, deliberate choices tied to the domain: a priority/status color language used consistently as the ONE accent system, a distinct type/spacing rhythm from sibling products, and small crafted touches (avatar initials, relative timestamps, status pills) that make the screen feel considered rather than assembled from a shared kit.

design_quality.evidence: Clear 3-zone layout (nav / list / detail), a real type scale used with intent (bold for actionable items, muted for metadata), generous but not wasteful whitespace, consistent 8px rhythm throughout.

originality.evidence: A status/priority color language (not a copy of a generic brand palette) is the product's own accent system, used consistently for badges, the sidebar active-state indicator, and chart accents nowhere else on the factory — a viewer could identify this product from a screenshot alone.

craft.evidence: Relative timestamps ('3h ago'), avatar-initial chips for assignees, status pills with both color AND text (never color-only), empty state has an illustration-free but specific message plus a primary action.

functionality.evidence: Every domain field reachable in create/edit, keyboard-navigable list, search debounced and functional, pagination state visible.

verdict_note: Clears every threshold — the bar the loop's terminal (winning) critique must reach. Note originality is earned by a DOMAIN-TIED decision (status/priority as the accent system), not by novelty for its own sake.
